Create a dense futuristic city block on a rectangular platform above a deep-blue void in strong daylight. Pack roughly six buildings around a dominant square office tower with red-brown glass bands, pale concrete mid-rises, and a weathered service building. Wrap an elevated concrete road around two sides in a right-angle curve, supported by heavy piers descending into the void. Beneath it, enclose a narrow service strip with noise barriers, retaining walls, columns, and dark doorways. Crowd the central rooftops with vents, tanks, ducts, antennas, and cables. Surround the block closely with much taller cylindrical, glass, rounded, and angular towers, leaving narrow void-filled gaps between their foundations.

=== THE TASK ===
Rebuild the place described above on the 200 m x 200 m plate, at the density
and arrangement the description calls for. Budget is 800 tool calls and 180
minutes; every tool result reports how much of both you have spent. Spend as
much or as little as the job needs, and decide for yourself when the scene
matches the description.

deterministic_rule_draft.prompt: Create a dense futuristic city block on a rectangular platform above a deep-blue void in strong daylight. Pack roughly six buildings around a dominant square office tower with red-brown glass bands, pale concrete mid-rises, and a weathered service building. Wrap an elevated concrete road around two sides in a right-angle curve, supported by heavy piers descending into the void. Beneath it, enclose a narrow service strip with noise barriers, retaining walls, columns, and dark doorways. Crowd the central rooftops with vents, tanks, ducts, antennas, and cables. Surround the block closely with much taller cylindrical, glass, rounded, and angular towers, leaving narrow void-filled gaps between their foundations.
